title: Docker Containerization
summary: Package applications with dependencies into portable containers for consistent environments.

content.overview: Docker packages applications with their dependencies into containers, enabling consistent execution across environments.
content.details: Benefits: consistent environments across dev/staging/prod; isolation between applications; easy scaling and orchestration. Best practices: use multi-stage builds to reduce image size; don't run as root inside containers; use .dockerignore to exclude unnecessary files; pin base image versions.
